name: hold-keeps-zdo
description: T-214 B1: a troll that stands still because the player (within 4 m) looks at it (TrollHold) is NOT counted as frozen, even when it should be travelling: after more than 30 s (the Rebuild rung) it has the same ZDO, the same backpack and was never rebuilt. Before the fix the watch rebuilt it at 30 s (cliff-walk-high-down). stt.forceTravelling makes the watch judge it as travelling; stt.startFarm makes it walk off so TrollHold engages.

steps.name: stt.forceTravelling
steps.label: the watch is told the troll should be travelling

steps.name: stt.forceTravelling
steps.label: back to the real travelling rule

asserts.name: stt.moved
asserts.label: it stood still for 40 s (the hold engaged, so the test measures the hold)

asserts.name: stt.followedZdoAlive
asserts.label: the ZDO is still there after more than 30 s held

asserts.name: stt.followedPackCount
asserts.label: the backpack is intact: the 7 Wood put in are still there (read from the ZDO); more is fine - a troll within 50 m picks up loose Wood while it is held, which depends on the simulation range

asserts.name: stt.trollFrozen
asserts.label: a held troll is not counted as frozen
